expectations.text: EVIDENCE fields contain '[from scored-card' citations with a source file reference, not vague claims
expectations.evidence: Baseline output uses no structured EVIDENCE fields and no '[from scored-card' citation format. Ideas are described in prose with generic research references but no sourced citation format.

expectations.text: Output contains a markdown table with columns: Rank, Candidate, Pattern, Evidence, Timing, Executable, Total
expectations.evidence: Baseline uses a priority table (Idea | Model | Key differentiator) but not the scoring rubric format. No Rank/Evidence/Timing/Executable/Total columns.

expectations.text: A file matching idea-seeds-*education* or idea-seeds-*greek* exists in ideas/_registry/ after the run
expectations.evidence: Baseline produced output.md only — no seed file written to ideas/_registry/. Ideas are not formatted as evaluator-ready seeds.

expectations.text: Output does NOT reproduce 'Greek Schools Directory' as a new candidate idea
expectations.evidence: Baseline correctly did not propose GSD again — it read the vault and noted it as existing before generating new ideas.

notes: Baseline produced high-quality ideas but without structured pipeline output: no evidence citations, no scoring table, no seed files in vault.
